title: Update on the mapping effort
content: This is going to take some time. I would imagine somewhere in the range of a few weeks to a month or two. If you are interested please draw it on paper and keep it private until we have a large enough number of people participating to be at least somewhat scientifically significant. Here is the discord link to help me keep track of how many people are working on it/ have a completed map: https://discord.gg/tShGeT7NmP
